title: Sure Attend
tagline: A web app for event registration with simplifies event organization
description: Your reliable companion for event management. Sure Attend simplifies event organization by ensuring participants commit to attending events they register for. With intuitive event creation, seamless participant registration, and robust attendance tracking, Sure Attend guarantees a smooth event experience for organizers and attendees alike.
how_its_made: This project utilizes the Scaffold-Stark 2 template alongside Next.js, Starknet-React, Typescript , Tailwind CSS (create a beautiful user interface) for the front end.  The contract was built using Starknet Foundry, Cairo, Scarb, and Snforge. I deployed my contracts on the Starknet  Testnet.
